name: print-social-blue-glass-pill-motivation-post-with-qr
title: Motivational post with three tilted blue pills, glass shape and QR code footer
whatItIs: A white-to-blue gradient 4:5 post with a small outlined 'How to be GREAT at it' pill, three stacked tilted pills in blue tones reading 'You focus', 'You practice', 'You improve', a translucent glass shape at the left edge, a serif-italic sign-off line, a QR code and social icons.
whatItMeans: Clear and encouraging; stacked pills make a three-step message feel like a small ladder.
techniques: Stack tilted capsule labels as a three-step list.
Use darker blues down the stack to imply progress.
Add a 3D glass object as a corner accent.
Close with QR code and handles.

vocabulary.definition: Rounded labels layered to form a list.
A translucent 3D shape used as decoration.
A scan code paired with handles at the bottom.
